messages.content: 尋找Netflix上《六人行》的電視節目列表及其評分，以及Hulu上《我們的辦公室》和《怪奇物語》的評分，並按照評分排序。

function.name: streaming_services_shows_list_and_ratings
function.description: Get a list of shows and their ratings on specific streaming services. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

streaming_service.description: Name of the streaming service. E.g., Netflix, Hulu, etc.

show_list.description: List of show names to search for on the platform.

sort_by_rating.description: If set to true, returns the list sorted by ratings. Defaults to false.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to find Netflix's "Six Feet Under" (likely "六人行" refers to "Six Feet Under") rating and show list? Actually they want "尋找Netflix上《六人行》的電視節目列表及其評分，以及Hulu上《我們的辦公室》和《怪奇物語》的評分，並按照評分排序。" So we need to get show list and ratings from Netflix for "Six Feet Under". Also get ratings from Hulu for "Our Office" (maybe "The Office"? Chinese title "我們的辦公室" could refer to "The Office") and "Stranger Things" ("怪奇物語"). Then sort by rating.

We have a function streaming_services_shows_list_and_ratings with parameters: streaming_service, show_list, sort_by_rating optional. We can call it twice: once for Netflix with show_list ["六人行"] or maybe English name "Six Feet Under". The function expects show names as strings; likely we should use English titles. But user used Chinese titles. Might pass Chinese titles but function may not understand. Use English titles: "Six Feet Under", "The Office", "Stranger Things".

We need to return results sorted by rating. The function has sort_by_rating param. For each request, we can set sort_by_rating=true. But we need separate calls per streaming service. So first call for Netflix with show_list ["Six Feet Under"], sort_by_rating=true. Second call for Hulu with show_list ["The Office","Stranger Things"], sort_by_rating=true.

Then combine results into a single response sorted by rating across all shows? Or just return each list sorted individually. The user says "並按照評分排序" meaning "and sort by rating." Could mean overall sorting across both lists. We'll produce combined sorted list.

We'll call function twice.
